simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to דְּמָמָה (H1827) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.

simple.summary: דְּמָמָה (dᵉmâmâh) means quiet First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 19 12.

definitions.full: H1827. demamah דְּמָמָה noun feminine (silence) whisper (on formation compare Ba NB 87 ) — דַקָּ֑ה דְּמָמָה קוֺל הָאֵשׁ וְאַחַר 1Kin 19:12 ; אֶשְׁמָ֑ע זָקוֺל דְּמָמָה Job 4:16 a whisper and a voice, i.e. an articulate whisper (compare Di); לִדְמָמָ֑ה סְעָרָה יָקֵם Psa 107:29 he settleth storm into whisper.
